The portable audio core exists in lib/audio.mjs: one deterministic mixer serves waveOut (open, write, reset, callback, per-channel volume), DirectSound (buffer lock/unlock, loop, decibel volume, decibel pan, play/write cursor, notification position, pause/resume), and an XAudio2 source-voice subset (buffer queue, loop count, volume, frequency ratio, OnBufferEnd) over a single-producer/consumer SharedArrayBuffer ring with underrun accounting, and the audio clock derives its position from the one monotonic guest clock (lib/clock.mjs). Every guest callback posts through an injected guest-thread dispatch.
promotion_trigger: Promote when FIX-007 produces the expected audio hash, callback trace, loop, volume, pan, and synchronization result after gesture activation.
expected_failing_assertion: The PCM fixture produces no verified WebAudio output through a real AudioWorklet after gesture activation.
